Title: Force of personality and "action goes as inblocked"

Messages.Author: Nac
Messages.Body:
Hi

I have a doubt regarding Force of personality's effect and something like a Torrent or a Form of mist. Is the "burn 1 blood" effect carried on, or is it lost?

Thanks in advance.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
It's kept for the duration of the action.  [TOM 19941109]

> Form of Mist:
> If the superior form is used to continue an action, then all action
> modifiers, including stealth and Dawn Operation, are still in effect.
> The superior version can be used by a blocking vampire, but this will
> not cause the action to be continued.
>

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
Force of Personality
Action Modifier/Combat
Presence
Cost: 1 Blood

[COMBAT] Strike: combat ends.
[ACTION MODIFIER] Only usable as the action is announced. Vampires must burn a blood to attempt to block this action. Non-zombie allies cannot block this action.

Finnish  Politics!
